name: Yuma Palms Regional Center
summary: Yuma Palms Regional Center is a sprawling, palm tree-studded outdoor lifestyle center featuring numerous stores, restaurants, and a movie theater. This highly-rated regional destination serves as Yuma's premier shopping and entertainment hub with convenient access and family-friendly amenities.
demographics: Yuma Palms Regional Center attracts a diverse demographic mix reflective of Yuma's border community, including young families, military personnel from nearby Marine Corps Air Station Yuma, and cross-border shoppers from Mexico. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $45,000 to $75,000, drawing from both Yuma County residents and international visitors. Primary shoppers include adults aged 25-54 who value convenience and variety, with significant weekend traffic from families seeking entertainment and dining options. The center benefits from Yuma's growing population and its position as a regional retail hub for southwestern Arizona and southeastern California communities.
description: Yuma Palms Regional Center stands as the premier shopping destination in Yuma, Arizona, offering a distinctive palm tree-studded outdoor shopping experience in the heart of the desert Southwest. This sprawling lifestyle center combines the convenience of major retail chains with diverse dining options and entertainment venues, including a modern movie theater that serves as a community gathering place. The center's open-air design takes advantage of Yuma's renowned sunny climate, creating an inviting atmosphere for shoppers year-round with its landscaped walkways and ample parking. Located at 1305 Yuma Palms Parkway, the center serves as a regional retail hub drawing visitors from across southwestern Arizona and neighboring communities in California and Mexico. With its strong tenant mix, family-friendly amenities, and strategic location near major transportation corridors, Yuma Palms Regional Center has established itself as an essential retail and entertainment destination for the Colorado River region, maintaining high customer satisfaction as evidenced by its 4.4-star rating from nearly 7,000 reviews.
